plugins.name: deliberation
plugins.description: A second opinion from other models before you ship. Any host, any vendor, one verdict, and the disagreement stays visible. GPT (Codex), Gemini, Grok (xAI), local, and OpenRouter (400+) models review your plan or diff through eight expert subagents (Architect, Plan Reviewer, Scope Analyst, Code Reviewer, Security Analyst, Researcher, Debugger, Writing Editor) and the ask-gpt/ask-gemini/ask-grok/ask-openrouter/ask-all/consensus commands. Every provider advises (read-only); only Gemini can also implement (write).
